W.note: Counts 4-7-5 (Na-cre-ous glow = 4), so line one is short, and 'holds its breath' is stock.

X.note: 5-7-5 (Win-ter dusk sun gone / a veil too high for the dark / holds moth-er-of-pearl); the high veil against the dark is a real turn and evokes polar stratospheric clouds accurately.

Y.note: 5-7-5 (sun gone from the street / a veil of ice up there still / burning pearl and rose); concrete street-to-sky contrast and ice-crystal accuracy, slightly less of a closing turn.

Z.note: 5-7-5 or 5-7-6 depending on 'fire' (Moth-er-of-pearl veils / na-cre-ous light at dusk slow / fire on fro-zen air); names nacreous and the frozen air but the lines are stacked and the break at 'slow' is awkward.
